gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-003 identifies the same erroneous normalization in eq:22122025a: the denominator is the norm of the normalized pair and hence equals one, rather than the diverging norm of the original multiplier pair. It correctly explains that boundedness of v_k then cannot yield a vanishing right-hand side, so the limiting abnormal-multiplier equation and the MFCQ contradiction, and consequently local boundedness, are unsupported. Its specific repair replaces the denominator with the original multiplier norm and uses divergence to recover the limit.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both the gold issue and ISSUE-003 diagnose the use of the identically-one norm of the normalized multipliers in place of the diverging original multiplier norm when dividing stationarity. This invalidates the claimed convergence to zero and the ensuing MFCQ contradiction and local-boundedness result.

component_coverage.gold_component: The stationarity equation is normalized by the wrong multiplier norm, so the denominator is identically one instead of the diverging norm of the original multiplier pair; consequently the right-hand side does not tend to zero and the MFCQ contradiction/local-boundedness proof is unsupported.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-003 independently states that the displayed denominator is identically one, gives the correct denominator involving the diverging original multiplier norm, identifies the failed limiting equation and MFCQ contradiction, and supplies the corresponding correction and limiting argument. It therefore covers the complete substantive gold concern.
